blocks.summary: While the lantern-lit streets draw the crowds, Hoi An's soul lives in its quiet workshops, hidden temples, and creative corners — here's where to find the real town.

cards.title: Tu Hoian by Ledactu
cards.why: A rooftop art gallery and cafe where local artists display work in a restored colonial house.

cards.title: HOIAN CRAFT SISTERS STUDIO
cards.why: Empowers local women through silk lantern making and embroidery workshops in a family-run space.

cards.title: Quan Cong Temple
cards.why: Dedicated to the legendary general Quan Cong, this quiet temple offers a peaceful escape from the Old Town bustle.

cards.title: Chùa Phước Bảo
cards.why: A working Buddhist temple where you can observe daily rituals and admire traditional Vietnamese architecture.

cards.title: Cửi Lụa Art Space - Coco Casa
cards.why: A contemporary gallery showcasing modern Vietnamese art alongside traditional silk crafts in a riverside setting.

cards.title: Hub Hoi An Coworking
cards.why: A modern coworking space that hosts art exhibitions, cultural events, and community gatherings.

cards.title: Phố Cổ Hoi An (Old Town Core)
cards.why: Explore the narrow back alleys away from the main tourist drag to find authentic local life.

cards.title: Thu Bồn River
cards.why: Take a quiet boat ride along the river at dawn or dusk to see the town from a different perspective.

blocks.conclusion: Start with a morning temple visit, spend the afternoon in a workshop, and end with a riverside sunset — that's how locals experience Hoi An.
